$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

xlsxInsertModel3dOp.description: 把本地 GLB 作为 3D 模型写入目标工作表。
xlsxInsertModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Write a local GLB as a 3D model on the target worksheet.
xlsxInsertModel3dOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不栅格化模型。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。
xlsxInsertModel3dOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. The model is not rasterized. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder.

xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.description: 换 GLB 字节，保留 graphicFrame 与关系 id。
xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Replace the GLB bytes. Keep the graphicFrame and the relationship id.
xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.limits: 海报仍写成 1×1 PNG。不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 3D 模型 id 报 InvalidId。不是 GLB 报 InvalidField。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.limitsEn: The poster stays a 1×1 PNG. Position and size are unchanged. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a 3D model id returns InvalidId. A non-GLB file returns InvalidField. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxDeleteModel3dOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 3D 模型 id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent；若锚点只剩 from / to / ext / pos / clientData 则删整个锚点。 GLB 与海报无人引用则删。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxDeleteModel3dOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a 3D model id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent; if the anchor has only from / to / ext / pos / clientData left, delete the whole anchor. If the GLB and the poster are unreferenced, delete them. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxInsertInkOp.description: 把本地 InkML 作为一笔墨迹写入目标工作表。
xlsxInsertInkOp.descriptionEn: Write a local InkML file as one ink stroke on the target worksheet.
xlsxInsertInkOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不把手写识别成字。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。
xlsxInsertInkOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. Handwriting is not recognized as text. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder.

xlsxReplaceInkOp.description: 换 InkML 字节，保留 contentPart 与关系 id。
xlsxReplaceInkOp.descriptionEn: Replace the InkML bytes. Keep the contentPart and the relationship id.
xlsxReplaceInkOp.limits: 不改海报，不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。不是 InkML 报 InvalidField。
xlsxReplaceInkOp.limitsEn: Do not change the poster, and do not change position or size. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an ink id returns InvalidId. A non-InkML file returns InvalidField.

xlsxDeleteInkOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent；若锚点只剩 from / to / ext / pos / clientData 则删整个锚点。 InkML 与海报无人引用则删。
xlsxDeleteInkOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an ink id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent; if the anchor has only from / to / ext / pos / clientData left, delete the whole anchor. If the InkML and the poster are unreferenced, delete them.

xlsxSetInkSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同。
xlsxSetInkSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize.
xlsxSetInkSizeOp.limits: id 必须是墨迹 id。oneCell / absolute 改外层 xdr:ext。twoCell 不认 cx / cy（出现报 InvalidField），必须给 to。对图 id 发此 op、对墨迹 id 发 setPictureSize 仍报 InvalidId。
xlsxSetInkSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be an ink id. oneCell / absolute updates the outer xdr:ext. twoCell does not accept cx / cy (those return InvalidField) and requires to. This op on a picture id, or setPictureSize on an ink id, still returns InvalidId.

xlsxInsertMathOp.description: 把一条线性公式写入目标工作表 drawing。
xlsxInsertMathOp.descriptionEn: Write one linear formula into the target worksheet drawing.
xlsxInsertMathOp.limits: 不进单元格 f。不进 textBoxes。不实现排版引擎。
xlsxInsertMathOp.limitsEn: It does not go into a cell f. It does not go into textBoxes. No layout engine is implemented.

xlsxSetMathOp.descriptionEn: Do not change the anchor or the size.
xlsxSetMathOp.limits: 出现 expr / kind 报 InvalidField。空 text 报 InvalidField。出现 x / y / cx / cy / from / to 报未知字段。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式框 id 报 InvalidId。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxSetMathOp.limitsEn: expr / kind returns InvalidField. An empty text returns InvalidField. x / y / cx / cy / from / to returns UnknownField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an equation box id returns InvalidId. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxDeleteMathOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式框 id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent；若锚点只剩 from / to / ext / pos / clientData 则删整个锚点。 海报无人引用则删。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxDeleteMathOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an equation box id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent; if the anchor has only from / to / ext / pos / clientData left, delete the whole anchor. If the poster is unreferenced, delete it. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxSetMathSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同。
xlsxSetMathSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize.
xlsxSetMathSizeOp.limits: id 必须是公式框 id。oneCell / absolute 改外层 xdr:ext。twoCell 不认 cx / cy（出现报 InvalidField），必须给 to。不按列宽行高去换算 EMU。留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData。对文本框 id 发此 op、对公式框 id 发 setTextBoxSize 仍报 InvalidId。docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
xlsxSetMathSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be an equation box id. oneCell / absolute updates the outer xdr:ext. twoCell does not accept cx / cy (those return InvalidField) and requires to. EMU is not converted from column width or row height. AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay. This op on a text box id, or setTextBoxSize on an equation box id, still returns InvalidId. This op on docx returns InvalidField.
